question: Choose the antonym of ‘resilient’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fragile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resilient"** means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or tough situations; being strong and adaptable. (लचीला, सहनशील)

 
 
• **Example:** After the storm, the resilient community came together to rebuild their homes.
 
 
 
• **"Fragile"** refers to something that is easily broken, damaged, or destroyed; lacking strength or resilience. (नाज़ुक, कमजोर)
 
 
• **Example:** The antique vase was so fragile that it broke with the slightest touch.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Resilient'** is **'Fragile'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fragile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tough** (कठोर): Strong and able to withstand difficult conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** She is tough enough to face any challenge that comes her way.
 
 
 
• **Buoyant** (उत्साही): Able to stay afloat or cheerful and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** His buoyant personality always lifts everyone's spirits.
 
 
 
• **Flexible** (लचीला): Capable of bending easily without breaking; adaptable.
 
 
• **Example:** The gymnast's flexible movements amazed the audience.
